name: LinkedIn Profile API | Scrape Public Profile Data
description: Collect public LinkedIn person profiles as clean, structured JSON. Send one or many profile URLs and get name, headline, location, current company, experience, education, and follower counts. Reliable, pay per profile, MCP-ready for Claude and AI agents.
